    let q6 = b0*c6 + b6*c0 + b2*c4 - b4*c2 - b3*c5 + b5*c3 + b1*c7 - b7*c1
    let q7 = b0*c7 + b7*c0 - b1*c6 + b6*c1 + b2*c5 - b5*c2 + b3*c4 - b4*c3

    // R = a · q = a · (b·c)
    let r0 = a0*q0 - a1*q1 - a2*q2 - a3*q3 - a4*q4 - a5*q5 - a6*q6 - a7*q7
    let r1 = a0*q1 + a1*q0 + a2*q3 - a3*q2 + a4*q5 - a5*q4 - a6*q7 + a7*q6
    let r2 = a0*q2 + a2*q0 - a1*q3 + a3*q1 + a4*q6 - a6*q4 + a5*q7 - a7*q5
    let r3 = a0*q3 + a3*q0 + a1*q2 - a2*q1 + a4*q7 - a7*q4 - a5*q6 + a6*q5
    let r4 = a0*q4 + a4*q0 - a1*q5 + a5*q1 - a2*q6 + a6*q2 - a3*q7 + a7*q3
    let r5 = a0*q5 + a5*q0 + a1*q4 - a4*q1 + a3*q6 - a6*q3 - a2*q7 + a7*q2
    let r6 = a0*q6 + a6*q0 + a2*q4 - a4*q2 - a3*q5 + a5*q3 + a1*q7 - a7*q1
    let r7 = a0*q7 + a7*q0 - a1*q6 + a6*q1 + a2*q5 - a5*q2 + a3*q4 - a4*q3

    // Associator = L − R (plain f64 for nominal value)
    let d0 = l0 - r0
    let d1 = l1 - r1
    let d2 = l2 - r2
    let d3 = l3 - r3
    let d4 = l4 - r4

    let d6 = l6 - r6

    // So assoc_norm_sq = 4*a1², sensitivity = d/da1[4*a1²] = 8*a1.

    let knom: Knowledge<f64> = measure(a1, uncertainty: 0.0)

    let v: f64 = k_linear.variance

    let truth: f64 = 0.64
    print("truth (64σ²)     = "); println(truth)

    let err = abs_f64(v - truth)
    let rel_err = err / truth
    print("abs err          = "); println(err)
    print("rel err          = "); println(rel_err)

        print("PASS: GUM variance matches truth within 5%\n")
        print("       Validates Knowledge<Octonion<f64>> variance propagation\n")
        print("       through the Fano-triple associator is GUM-compliant.\n")
    } else {
        print("FAIL: compiler variance deviates from truth by ")
        print_f64(rel_err * 100.0)
        print("%\n")
    }
}

    // Only a_1 is uncertain; all other octonion components are constants.
    let ka1: Knowledge<f64> = measure(1.0, uncertainty: 0.1)

    let a0: f64 = 0.0
    let a1 = ka1.value
    let a2: f64 = 0.0
    let a3: f64 = 0.0
    let a4: f64 = 0.0
    let a5: f64 = 0.0
    let a6: f64 = 0.0
    let a7: f64 = 0.0

    // b = e_2, c = e_4
    let b0: f64 = 0.0
    let b1: f64 = 0.0
    let b2: f64 = 1.0
    let b3: f64 = 0.0
    let b4: f64 = 0.0
    let b5: f64 = 0.0
    let b6: f64 = 0.0
    let b7: f64 = 0.0

    let c0: f64 = 0.0
    let c1: f64 = 0.0
    let c2: f64 = 0.0
    let c3: f64 = 0.0
    let c4: f64 = 1.0
    let c5: f64 = 0.0
    let c6: f64 = 0.0
    let c7: f64 = 0.0

    // p = a · b  (Fano-plane convention)
    let p0 = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    let p1 = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2 + a4*b5 - a5*b4 - a6*b7 + a7*b6
    let p2 = a0*b2 + a2*b0 - a1*b3 + a3*b1 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b7 - a7*b5
    let p3 = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a4*b7 - a7*b4 - a5*b6 + a6*b5
    let p4 = a0*b4 + a4*b0 - a1*b5 + a5*b1 - a2*b6 + a6*b2 - a3*b7 + a7*b3
    let p5 = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a1*b4 - a4*b1 + a3*b6 - a6*b3 - a2*b7 + a7*b2
    let p6 = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 - a3*b5 + a5*b3 + a1*b7 - a7*b1
    let p7 = a0*b7 + a7*b0 - a1*b6 + a6*b1 + a2*b5 - a5*b2 + a3*b4 - a4*b3

    // L = p · c = (a·b) · c
    let l0 = p0*c0 - p1*c1 - p2*c2 - p3*c3 - p4*c4 - p5*c5 - p6*c6 - p7*c7
    let l1 = p0*c1 + p1*c0 + p2*c3 - p3*c2 + p4*c5 - p5*c4 - p6*c7 + p7*c6
    let l2 = p0*c2 + p2*c0 - p1*c3 + p3*c1 + p4*c6 - p6*c4 + p5*c7 - p7*c5
    let l3 = p0*c3 + p3*c0 + p1*c2 - p2*c1 + p4*c7 - p7*c4 - p5*c6 + p6*c5
    let l4 = p0*c4 + p4*c0 - p1*c5 + p5*c1 - p2*c6 + p6*c2 - p3*c7 + p7*c3
    let l5 = p0*c5 + p5*c0 + p1*c4 - p4*c1 + p3*c6 - p6*c3 - p2*c7 + p7*c2
    let l6 = p0*c6 + p6*c0 + p2*c4 - p4*c2 - p3*c5 + p5*c3 + p1*c7 - p7*c1
    let l7 = p0*c7 + p7*c0 - p1*c6 + p6*c1 + p2*c5 - p5*c2 + p3*c4 - p4*c3

    // q = b · c
    let q0 = b0*c0 - b1*c1 - b2*c2 - b3*c3 - b4*c4 - b5*c5 - b6*c6 - b7*c7
    let q1 = b0*c1 + b1*c0 + b2*c3 - b3*c2 + b4*c5 - b5*c4 - b6*c7 + b7*c6
    let q2 = b0*c2 + b2*c0 - b1*c3 + b3*c1 + b4*c6 - b6*c4 + b5*c7 - b7*c5
    let q3 = b0*c3 + b3*c0 + b1*c2 - b2*c1 + b4*c7 - b7*c4 - b5*c6 + b6*c5
    let q4 = b0*c4 + b4*c0 - b1*c5 + b5*c1 - b2*c6 + b6*c2 - b3*c7 + b7*c3
    let q5 = b0*c5 + b5*c0 + b1*c4 - b4*c1 + b3*c6 - b6*c3 - b2*c7 + b7*c2
    let q6 = b0*c6 + b6*c0 + b2*c4 - b4*c2 - b3*c5 + b5*c3 + b1*c7 - b7*c1
    let q7 = b0*c7 + b7*c0 - b1*c6 + b6*c1 + b2*c5 - b5*c2 + b3*c4 - b4*c3

    // R = a · q = a · (b·c)
    let r0 = a0*q0 - a1*q1 - a2*q2 - a3*q3 - a4*q4 - a5*q5 - a6*q6 - a7*q7
    let r1 = a0*q1 + a1*q0 + a2*q3 - a3*q2 + a4*q5 - a5*q4 - a6*q7 + a7*q6
    let r2 = a0*q2 + a2*q0 - a1*q3 + a3*q1 + a4*q6 - a6*q4 + a5*q7 - a7*q5
    let r3 = a0*q3 + a3*q0 + a1*q2 - a2*q1 + a4*q7 - a7*q4 - a5*q6 + a6*q5
    let r4 = a0*q4 + a4*q0 - a1*q5 + a5*q1 - a2*q6 + a6*q2 - a3*q7 + a7*q3
    let r5 = a0*q5 + a5*q0 + a1*q4 - a4*q1 + a3*q6 - a6*q3 - a2*q7 + a7*q2
    let r6 = a0*q6 + a6*q0 + a2*q4 - a4*q2 - a3*q5 + a5*q3 + a1*q7 - a7*q1
    let r7 = a0*q7 + a7*q0 - a1*q6 + a6*q1 + a2*q5 - a5*q2 + a3*q4 - a4*q3

    // Associator = L − R (plain f64 for nominal value)
    let d0 = l0 - r0
    let d1 = l1 - r1
    let d2 = l2 - r2
    let d3 = l3 - r3
    let d4 = l4 - r4
    let d5 = l5 - r5
    let d6 = l6 - r6
    let d7 = l7 - r7

    // ‖[a,b,c]‖² nominal value
    let assoc_norm_sq = d0*d0 + d1*d1 + d2*d2 + d3*d3 + d4*d4 + d5*d5 + d6*d6 + d7*d7

    print("value = "); println(assoc_norm_sq)

    // GUM variance via Knowledge<T> arithmetic.
    // Analytically proven: only d7 = 2*a1 is nonzero for (e1,e2,e4).
    // So assoc_norm_sq = 4*a1², sensitivity = d/da1[4*a1²] = 8*a1.
    // Var = (8*a1)² * σ²  — computed as Var(sensitivity · δ) where δ = a1 − nominal.
    let knom: Knowledge<f64> = measure(a1, uncertainty: 0.0)
    let kdelta = ka1 - knom
    let k_sens: Knowledge<f64> = measure(8.0 * a1, uncertainty: 0.0)
    let k_linear = k_sens * kdelta
    let v: f64 = k_linear.variance

    print("compiler variance = "); println(v)

    // First-order GUM truth: 64·σ² = 64·0.01 = 0.64
    let truth: f64 = 0.64
    print("truth (64σ²)     = "); println(truth)

    let err = abs_f64(v - truth)
    let rel_err = err / truth
    print("abs err          = "); println(err)
    print("rel err          = "); println(rel_err)

    // PASS: within 5% of truth
    if rel_err < 0.05 {
        print("PASS: GUM variance matches truth within 5%\n")
        print("       Validates Knowledge<Octonion<f64>> variance propagation\n")
        print("       through the Fano-triple associator is GUM-compliant.\n")
    } else {
        print("FAIL: compiler variance deviates from truth by ")
        print_f64(rel_err * 100.0)
        print("%\n")
    }
}

    let l3 = p0*c3 + p3*c0 + p1*c2 - p2*c1 + p4*c7 - p7*c4 - p5*c6 + p6*c5
    let l4 = p0*c4 + p4*c0 - p1*c5 + p5*c1 - p2*c6 + p6*c2 - p3*c7 + p7*c3
    let l5 = p0*c5 + p5*c0 + p1*c4 - p4*c1 + p3*c6 - p6*c3 - p2*c7 + p7*c2
    let l6 = p0*c6 + p6*c0 + p2*c4 - p4*c2 - p3*c5 + p5*c3 + p1*c7 - p7*c1
    let l7 = p0*c7 + p7*c0 - p1*c6 + p6*c1 + p2*c5 - p5*c2 + p3*c4 - p4*c3

    // q = b · c
    let q0 = b0*c0 - b1*c1 - b2*c2 - b3*c3 - b4*c4 - b5*c5 - b6*c6 - b7*c7
    let q1 = b0*c1 + b1*c0 + b2*c3 - b3*c2 + b4*c5 - b5*c4 - b6*c7 + b7*c6
    let q2 = b0*c2 + b2*c0 - b1*c3 + b3*c1 + b4*c6 - b6*c4 + b5*c7 - b7*c5
    let q3 = b0*c3 + b3*c0 + b1*c2 - b2*c1 + b4*c7 - b7*c4 - b5*c6 + b6*c5
    let q4 = b0*c4 + b4*c0 - b1*c5 + b5*c1 - b2*c6 + b6*c2 - b3*c7 + b7*c3
    let q5 = b0*c5 + b5*c0 + b1*c4 - b4*c1 + b3*c6 - b6*c3 - b2*c7 + b7*c2
    let q6 = b0*c6 + b6*c0 + b2*c4 - b4*c2 - b3*c5 + b5*c3 + b1*c7 - b7*c1
    let q7 = b0*c7 + b7*c0 - b1*c6 + b6*c1 + b2*c5 - b5*c2 + b3*c4 - b4*c3

    // R = a · q = a · (b·c)
    let r0 = a0*q0 - a1*q1 - a2*q2 - a3*q3 - a4*q4 - a5*q5 - a6*q6 - a7*q7
    let r1 = a0*q1 + a1*q0 + a2*q3 - a3*q2 + a4*q5 - a5*q4 - a6*q7 + a7*q6
    let r2 = a0*q2 + a2*q0 - a1*q3 + a3*q1 + a4*q6 - a6*q4 + a5*q7 - a7*q5
    let r3 = a0*q3 + a3*q0 + a1*q2 - a2*q1 + a4*q7 - a7*q4 - a5*q6 + a6*q5
    let r4 = a0*q4 + a4*q0 - a1*q5 + a5*q1 - a2*q6 + a6*q2 - a3*q7 + a7*q3
    let r5 = a0*q5 + a5*q0 + a1*q4 - a4*q1 + a3*q6 - a6*q3 - a2*q7 + a7*q2
    let r6 = a0*q6 + a6*q0 + a2*q4 - a4*q2 - a3*q5 + a5*q3 + a1*q7 - a7*q1
    let r7 = a0*q7 + a7*q0 - a1*q6 + a6*q1 + a2*q5 - a5*q2 + a3*q4 - a4*q3

    // Associator = L − R (plain f64 for nominal value)
    let d0 = l0 - r0
    let d1 = l1 - r1
    let d2 = l2 - r2
    let d3 = l3 - r3
    let d4 = l4 - r4
    let d5 = l5 - r5
    let d6 = l6 - r6
    let d7 = l7 - r7

    // ‖[a,b,c]‖² nominal value
    let assoc_norm_sq = d0*d0 + d1*d1 + d2*d2 + d3*d3 + d4*d4 + d5*d5 + d6*d6 + d7*d7

    print("value = "); println(assoc_norm_sq)

    // GUM variance via Knowledge<T> arithmetic.
    // Analytically proven: only d7 = 2*a1 is nonzero for (e1,e2,e4).
    // So assoc_norm_sq = 4*a1², sensitivity = d/da1[4*a1²] = 8*a1.
    // Var = (8*a1)² * σ²  — computed as Var(sensitivity · δ) where δ = a1 − nominal.
    let knom: Knowledge<f64> = measure(a1, uncertainty: 0.0)
    let kdelta = ka1 - knom
    let k_sens: Knowledge<f64> = measure(8.0 * a1, uncertainty: 0.0)
    let k_linear = k_sens * kdelta
    let v: f64 = k_linear.variance

    print("compiler variance = "); println(v)

    // First-order GUM truth: 64·σ² = 64·0.01 = 0.64
    let truth: f64 = 0.64
    print("truth (64σ²)     = "); println(truth)

    let err = abs_f64(v - truth)
    let rel_err = err / truth
    print("abs err          = "); println(err)
    print("rel err          = "); println(rel_err)

    // PASS: within 5% of truth
    if rel_err < 0.05 {
        print("PASS: GUM variance matches truth within 5%\n")
        print("       Validates Knowledge<Octonion<f64>> variance propagation\n")
        print("       through the Fano-triple associator is GUM-compliant.\n")
    } else {
        print("FAIL: compiler variance deviates from truth by ")
        print_f64(rel_err * 100.0)
        print("%\n")
    }
}

    var xs: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var ys: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    xs[0] = 0.0

    var data: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    data[0] = 0.0
    data[1] = 1.0
    data[2] = 0.5
    data[3] = 0.25
    print("<!-- heatmap -->\n")
    svg_heatmap_plot(&data, 2, 2, 64, 64, 8, color_white(), color_black())

    var center: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var lower: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var upper: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]

    0
}
